content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for WCD Maharashtra Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website:kolhapur.gov.in/ . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Maharashtra Anganwadi Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the WCD Maharashtra Anganwadi Helper recruitment is 14-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for Anganwadi Helper posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Anganwadi Helper posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for Anganwadi Helper posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Anganwadi Helper posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation for widows, who can apply up to 40 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Anganwadi Helper posts is passing the 12th grade (12th Pass).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Anganwadi Helper position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Anganwadi Helper position is Rs. 7500 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Anganwadi Helper posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Anganwadi Helper posts is based on Nomination.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
